text:
maya: Quick preflight — planning to flip feature flag `client_timeouts.soft_limit` tonight at 23:00 UTC for a staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%). PR: https://git.redwood/infra/flags/1234  Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/flag-rollout#client-timeouts

oliver: I can own the deploy. Do we have a short smoke checklist and safe defaults to apply if something goes wrong?

maya: TL;DR checklist below. Safe default is `soft_limit=false` and `client_timeout_ms=5000`. Full runbook linked above but short checks: 1) quick health curl, 2) run 30s synthetic qps against _canary_ route, 3) verify p95 latency and errors on dashboards, 4) confirm no increase in tail OOMs in infra logs.

maya: smoke commands (copy):
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood/internal/health || exit 1
./scripts/synth-load --target /v1/generate --qps 20 --duration 30 --tag canary
```

sasha: For the staged %s, what's the cadence? 10% for 15m, 30% for 30m, then 100? Also who is watching dashboards?

maya: Yes — 10% for 15m -> 30% for 30m -> 100% if all green. @jun will watch infra and alert channels; @oliver will monitor app metrics and rollback if errors > 0.5% or p95 increases > 300ms.

jun: If we need to rollback quickly, what's the command?

maya: Rollback is toggle flip: `redwoodctl flags set client_timeouts.soft_limit false --env prod`  followed by `redwoodctl rollout abort deployment/<id>` if any rollout stuck. Dashboards to watch: `infra/latency`, `app/errors`, `runtime/ooms`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy by oliver at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z (id: dpl-7890)

oliver: Kicking off now. Will post smoke results in-thread. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy started dpl-7890 — step: flag-toggle -> routing -> canary

oliver: smoke: health ok, synth run shows p95 420ms -> baseline 400ms, errors 0.12% -> baseline 0.09% (within agreed thresholds).

jun: Observing infra: no new OOM alerts, no spike on p99. Logs show a couple of auth retries but nothing systemic.

maya: Good. Proceeding to 30% in 10m if all still green. Thanks @oliver, @jun. :thumbsup:

oliver: ack, will recheck and report back.

maya: Note for posterity: safe-default snippet saved in flags repo: ```json
{"client_timeouts": {"soft_limit": false, "client_timeout_ms": 5000}}
```

oliver: 30% cutover done, monitoring now. No regressions so far.

jun: will keep eyes on infra/alerts for next 45m. ping if anything odd.

maya: Leaving the post-rollout checklist here: 1) tag release + changelog, 2) update runbook with any anomalies, 3) schedule a 1h follow-up if rollback happened.

oliver: all done, closing the loop later today. :white_check_mark:
